not_modelled.the private key file: Serialized by the implementation's portable libp2p key representation and written owner-only. It is not a document, never leaves the machine, and must not acquire a schema that would invite treating it as transferable.
not_modelled.SLIP-0039 threshold shares: A future format over the same 32-byte seed. Out of scope until decided; ADR-0033 records it as future work rather than v1 shape.
